files.description: Hotel bookings (300 rows): booking_id (whole number), state (paid, cancelled, refunded or pending; mostly lower case, some with other capitals or extra spaces), total (booking amount, two decimals; refunded bookings are negative), nights (whole number; about 2% empty).

task_text: Refunded bookings have a negative total. For the revenue report, count every negative total as 0 and give the overall sum of the totals, rounded to two decimals. `result` should be that number.
intended_computation: Replace the 37 negative totals by 0 and return the sum of total over all 300 bookings, rounded to 2 decimals.

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.x a write through a column taken out of the table no longer changes the table, so negatives stay in the sum
